description: The agent run passed its deadline. The Codex bridge bounds a run at ten minutes; the server then ends the run with error limit and this failure. The browser transport's twelve-minute deadline is a backstop behind the bridge's and reports the same failure. The vercel engine has no whole-run deadline: the relay bounds each request at ten minutes and two minutes idle.

items.message: The AI request timed out. Its outcome may be uncertain; review completed work before continuing.
